blocks.text: You can drill down data from applications to sensitive assets discovered by clicking View All for any widget of the MS Copilot Readiness Assessment page. To learn more, see About MS Copilot Readiness Assessment.
To drill down for specific assets:

blocks.item: TIme Range: Select the time period for which you want to see the data. You can select data for Current Day, Current Week, Last 24 Hours, Last 7 Days, Last 15 Days, or Custom.
Applications: Filter the data for any application (OneDrive, Sharepoint, or MS Teams).
Exposure: Select the exposure level (Org-Wide, External Link, <10 Users, 10–99 Users, 100–999 Users, 1000–9999 Users, and >=10000 Users).

blocks.text: The page displays the Sensitive Assets table. For each asset, you can view:

blocks.item: Asset Name: The name of the asset.
DLP Engine:The DLP engine matched for the asset.
Tenant: The name of the application tenant.
Risk: The risk posed by the asset.
DLP Classification: The DLP classification for the asset.
Internal Collaborators: The number of internal collaborators.
External Collaborators: The number of external collaborators.

blocks.text: You can modify the columns or search for a specific asset by its name.
